Additional seats may also be filled from the eligible candidates at the time of physical counselling.
The eligible candidates, who have not got admission due to non-
registration for counselling/non-reporting during the 1st and 2nd counselling, are also
eligible to participate in the physical counselling. The eligibility of LDV seats are
reduced up to 45 marks of Entrance Test.
If any candidate wishes to withdraw his/her seat, he/she must submit
the withdrawal request in the Academic Branch Office of the Registrar by 23.09.2026.
The details of vacant seats will be available at University website on 25.09.2026.
For the latest updates regarding admission to Undergraduate and
Postgraduate Programmes, candidates and their parents are advised to regularly visit
the University websites: admissions.hau.ac.in and hau.ac.in.
